lev.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ilya.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

owen.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

mae.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

nell.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

jo.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

ada.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

ruth.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

anna.direction: Anna, Lev's mother, an adult woman. Warm, intimate and reassuring.

voice.direction: A distant mysterious female voice from the last row of a bus. Very quiet and restrained, distinctly audible. No added sound effects.
